name: routing
instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to support chat. Which issue is the customer asking about?

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: a charge or card payment the customer does not recognise or did not make, e.g. 'I have an unknown charge.', 'There is a mysterious debit transaction on my statement', 'Is there a way for you to find out why my account was deducted from a seller when I didn't approve of it?'
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: a cash/ATM withdrawal the customer did not make, cash missing from the account, a cash withdrawal in the app that the customer never received, e.g. 'I AM MISSING CASH FROM MY BANK ACCOUNT', 'I see non-received cash in my app.'
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: a direct debit the customer does not recognise or wants money back from, e.g. 'I want a refund on a direct debit.'
criteria.compromised_card: card details may have been stolen or used by someone else, suspicious activity, wants to freeze card or stop a transaction on the card, e.g. 'I need to cancel a transaction on my debit card.' (cancelling a purchase to get the money back is a refund request)
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: card lost or stolen, including fees or charges after the card was stolen, e.g. 'A fee shouldn't apply to me if my card was stolen.'
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: phone with the app lost, stolen or left somewhere, e.g. 'phone is at a hotel, can i still use app'
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot app passcode or cannot log in to the app
criteria.request_refund: wants a refund for a purchase, to cancel a purchase, or to get money back from a merchant, e.g. 'I want to cancel my purchase'
criteria.refund_not_showing: a refund the merchant issued has not appeared
criteria.charged_twice: same transaction charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash: ATM gave less cash than requested or the wrong amount, customer could not get the cash amount they wanted, e.g. 'I could not get the cash I wanted', 'Do any of your machines provide cash from my home country?', 'I haven't received my cash yet.', 'Where'd the rest of my cash go from the ATM'
criteria.reverted_card_payment: a card payment was reverted, returned or cancelled, e.g. 'Why would my card payment be cancelled?', 'I have cancelled payments to this card.'
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: charged more than the price, or an extra charge on the statement (even if pending), e.g. 'There is a pending 1£ charge on my statement. I haven't purchased anything for 1£.', 'Can you tell me what this fee is on my statement?' (a known fee type that should not have been charged goes to the fee options)
criteria.card_arrival: new card has not arrived, customer waiting for or demanding their card, tracking card delivery, e.g. 'Give me my card, I need it now!'
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes, delivery dates
criteria.card_linking: linking/adding a card to the app or account, found a card previously reported lost and wants to use it again, e.g. 'I recently reported my card as missing/lost, and I just found it. Can I still use it?'
criteria.declined_card_payment: card payment or purchase declined at a shop or online, e.g. 'I've made more than one attempt to make a purchase and the card keeps getting declined.'
criteria.order_physical_card: ordering or getting a physical card, another card or spare card, having a new card sent somewhere, e.g. 'Will you send me a new card in China?'
criteria.virtual_card: getting a virtual card or disposable virtual card, virtual card not working, disposable card limits
criteria.apple_pay_google_pay: Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up or paying through them, e.g. 'Is it possible to top up with Google Pay?'
criteria.transfer_not_received: a transfer the customer sent has not arrived at the recipient, or incoming transfer not arrived
criteria.pending_transfer: transfer pending, how long transfers take, questions about a transaction/transfer the customer made (e.g. no receipt for it)
criteria.cancel_transfer: cancel a transfer or a transaction, or a payment sent to the wrong account, e.g. 'One of my transactions needs to be canceled.'
criteria.receiving_money: receiving money, getting salary paid in, transferring money into the account (including in another currency), e.g. 'How can you transfer my salary to my correct currency?'
criteria.balance_not_updated: balance not updated after a bank transfer, cheque or cash deposit; money missing or disappeared from the balance without mention of an unknown transaction, e.g. 'My money disappeared! Please help??'
criteria.pending_card_payment: card payment pending or delayed at a shop or petrol station, e.g. 'Needed gas, been delayed for half an hour. Please fix it!'
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: cash withdrawal pending, or the balance still shows money the customer already withdrew in cash, e.g. 'My account says I have money but I withdrew it in cash.'
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: cash withdrawal declined at ATM, card not working at the ATM, e.g. 'My card isn't working at the ATM and I know I used the right PIN. Trying to get my money.'
criteria.top_up: how to top up, top up by card, cash or cheque, top-up methods, auto top-up, top-up limits, daily limits on the card, e.g. 'What is the daily limit on my card?'
criteria.top_up_problem: top-up failed, pending, reverted, or not showing, verify top-up card
criteria.card_payment_fee: fee charged on a card payment, unexpected extra fees when paying (including abroad), a fee the customer thinks should not apply, e.g. 'I received a fee I should not have.'
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: fee charged for ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.transfer_fee: fee charged for a transfer, recipient received less than the amount sent, whether the full amount of an incoming transfer arrives, e.g. 'Will I receive all the money sent to my account by SEPA transfer?'
criteria.top_up_fee: fee for topping up by card or bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate: exchange rates, wrong exchange rate on a payment or withdrawal
criteria.exchange_via_app: how to exchange currency in the app
criteria.currencies_supported: which currencies (fiat or crypto) are supported
criteria.verify_identity: identity verification: how, why, documents, verification failing
criteria.source_of_funds: verifying source of funds, where the money in the account comes from, e.g. 'Who is giving me my money?'
criteria.edit_personal_details: changing name, address or personal details
criteria.account_security: general questions about how the bank keeps customers' money and accounts safe, e.g. 'What kind of security protects my money?'
criteria.buy_crypto: trying to buy or purchase cryptocurrency in the app and it isn't going through, e.g. 'I'm on the app and trying to purchase crypto. It's not going through.' (crypto top-ups belong with top-up problems)
criteria.age_limit: age requirement to open an account
criteria.country_support: which countries the bank serves, whether the account/card can be used all over the world or abroad, getting a card or account while living in another country, e.g. 'Can I use this all over the world?', 'How do I sign up for a card if I'm in America?'
